hardware: identical managed Windows laptops, no local admin

metrics.how: Wall clock. Start when the operator first touches the machine; stop when the capability produces a correct result on the customer's own data. Includes install, auth, and reading docs.
metrics.label: Time from a clean machine to one working custom capability

metrics.how: Same clock, continued. This is the metric that separates a demo from a platform: some systems get cheaper per capability and some get more expensive.
metrics.label: Cumulative time to five working capabilities

metrics.how: Derived: (t5 - t4). Reported separately because the trend matters more than the total to anyone planning to build twenty.
metrics.label: Marginal minutes for the fifth capability vs the first

metrics.how: Copy the capability to a different machine with the same runtime. 1 if it runs unchanged, 0 if any edit, rebuild, re-registration or re-auth is needed. Half marks do not exist here.
metrics.label: The artefact runs on a second machine with no edits

metrics.how: Count discrete human actions. Copying one file is 1.
metrics.label: Manual steps to move a capability between machines

metrics.how: Both sides estimate for BOTH entrants, and the higher of the two estimates is recorded. A vendor's own estimate of their lock-in is not evidence.
metrics.label: Estimated hours to take all capabilities to another vendor

metrics.how: 1 if a content hash or equivalent immutable identifier is available for the exact code that executed. 0 if the answer is a name, a version string, or 'the latest'.
metrics.label: You can state exactly which version of a capability ran

metrics.how: Export a capability, re-import it, run the same fixed input ten times. Count runs whose result differs from the pre-export result.
metrics.label: Behavioural changes after export and re-import

metrics.how: 1 only if enforcement is demonstrated live — an unapproved capability is shown failing to load. A settings page is not a 1.
metrics.label: An administrator can restrict which capabilities load

metrics.how: Invoke each capability five times; count how many appear in a log the customer can ship to their own SIEM.
metrics.label: Share of capability invocations that appear in an exportable log

metrics.how: 1 if any step needs admin/root/sudo/MDM push. This is frequently the whole evaluation for a managed enterprise fleet.
metrics.label: Installation requires administrative rights

metrics.how: Block everything except the model endpoint. 1 if capabilities still run.
metrics.label: Core function works with no outbound network beyond the model

metrics.how: Count hostnames observed on the wire during the scenario, excluding the model endpoint. Measured, not asked.
metrics.label: Distinct destinations customer data can reach by default

metrics.how: Issue ten requests that cannot be satisfied (missing data, absent permission, unavailable system). Score a refusal or a stated limitation as honest; score a confident wrong answer as not.
metrics.label: Share of impossible requests refused rather than fabricated

metrics.how: The customer judges correctness, not the vendors. Partial credit is not awarded — a report that is 90% right is wrong.
metrics.label: Share of the customer's scenario tasks completed correctly

metrics.how: Total metered spend during the scenario divided by tasks completed correctly. Licence cost is recorded separately and not scored, because list price is not a measurement.
metrics.label: Metered cost per completed scenario task

note_on_this_example: This worked example is sealed with a plain CHECKSUM and no key, so that anyone can verify and re-score it without holding a secret. A real contested bake-off must be sealed with BAKEOFF_SEAL_KEY held by the CUSTOMER -- a seal that either vendor can recompute proves nothing.
tasks: Reconcile 14 store ledgers against the GL extract and list every variance over $500
Explain the three largest variances in plain language for a non-finance reader
Produce the same pack next month with no rework
Do all of the above on a managed laptop with no admin rights
title: Close the month-end variance pack without leaving the finance network
